details: A ceasefire between Israel and Lebanon along with the reopening of the Strait of Hormuz has led to a cryptocurrency market rally, with Ethereum rising above $2,400 and Bitcoin hitting a two-month high, driven by easing global tensions and institutional interest in spot ETH ETFs.
title: Geopolitical De-escalation in Middle East Propels Crypto Rally

details: The IMF has lowered its 2026 global growth forecast to 3.1% due to the Middle East conflict, while the Financial Stability Board has warned of potential market shocks arising from stretched asset valuations and high leverage in non-bank sectors.
title: IMF Downgrades Global Growth Amid Middle East Conflict, FSB Warns of Risks
